## GET `/api/2.29/telemetry-metrics-collections`

**Tier:** T0  

Displays a list of telemetry metrics collections. Collections are pre-defined groupings of related metrics with supported resolutions. Collections are read-only and cannot be created, modified, or deleted.

## GET `/api/2.29/telemetry-metrics-collections/metrics`

**Tier:** T0  

Lists the membership relationships between telemetry metrics collections and metrics. This operation returns which metrics belong to which collections. It supports a many-to-many relationship model, allowing metrics to belong to multiple collections (though currently all collections are system-defined and non-overlapping).
